learnings: WSGI (`application(environ, start_response)`) is the contract every Python host speaks.
A `/health` endpoint lets uptime monitors check the deployment.
Configuration comes from environment variables, so the same code runs locally and in the cloud.
pitfalls: Paths in the PythonAnywhere WSGI file must be absolute; usernames are validated before generating it.
